name: Kayoinbo ~Waga Ko no Geshuku de Onna ni Modoru Haha~
original_name: 通淫母～我が子の下宿でオンナに戻る母～
source: The protagonist, Kanbara Tooru, has just started living alone in the spring. His mother, Chihiro, calls him almost daily with nagging questions, which he finds annoying. Despite this, he often relies on his friend's mother and the owner of the apartment, Inami Akiho, who is of a similar age to his mother but has a more attractive physique. Tooru is surrounded by attractive adult women, such as his aunt Aiba Mutsumi and former teacher Sogawa Atsuko. When his mother Chihiro comes to visit him, he starts to appreciate her love and care, as well as realizing that she is as glamorous as Akiho, which leads him to ask her for a sexual encounter.
translation: 主人公神原透在春天开始了独居生活。他的母亲千寻几乎每天都会打电话给他，问一些烦人的问题，这让他觉得很烦人。尽管如此，他还是经常依赖朋友的母亲、公寓的主人稻波明步，她与母亲年龄相仿，但体格更有吸引力。透周围都是漂亮的成年女性，比如他的姨妈相叶睦美和前老师曾川敦子。当他的母亲千寻来看望他时，他开始感激她的爱和关怀，并意识到她和秋穗一样迷人，这促使他向她提出性接触。
